mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-3801, 15531) and has to end up at (2081, 6312). On the way it must stop at A (Tokyo Metropolitan Tama Medical Center Heliport) at (-26018, 4662), B (NEC Tamagawa Solution Center Helipad) at (-7550, -8713), C (Cross Gate Helipad) at (-10603, -22162), D (Chiba Prefectural Sewage Plant Helipad) at (26972, -2259); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Tokyo Haneda International Airport (RJTT, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Chofu Airport (RJTF, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z3 [JMSDF Shimofusa Air Base (RJTL, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 143688 meters. The battery only allows 150353 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Ukima Heliport; DEST is Ueno Frontier Tower Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
